observed_failure: The program exits0 and prints Validation: PASSED despite Clusters found:0 and Points clustered:0/1001. All membership values are -1 (sum -1001) instead of the reference membership sum55165.
finding: The dynamic shared-memory layout places int members at byte offset N and double reduction values at byte offset5*N, without alignment padding. At N=1001 these are misaligned for their element types. The host ignores return codes from kernel synchronization and result copies; zero-initialized cardinalities then allow the clustering loop to stop without assigning any point. The misaligned layout and unchecked CUDA errors are consistent with the observed empty result, though the exact failing device instruction was not traced.
interpretation: Confirmed independent numerical failure on the approved odd-size case. Retain failed external validation without retry; no CUDA tracing or source edits are needed for disposition.
investigation: Static source/layout inspection and retained exclusive correctness output; no new program execution.
